audit.why: full phases[N].side and content win[N] agree row for row and match the packet: Darius 1 through 4-5, Skill at 6, Master Yi at first item and 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere in the content spikes.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 and drops to 16s at rank 5 — the single longest gate on his kill combo, and the number that makes 'bait the E' actionable. Noxian Guillotine is 120/100/80s, Decimate 9/8/7/6/5s, Highlander a flat 85s.
audit.corrected: spikes[0..2], early and mid now carry the E, Q, R and Highlander numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls his E 'Apprehension' in four places — the real name is Apprehend. It also has you Meditating through his combo, but Apprehend knocks up and cancels the channel outright. Nothing states that Noxian Guillotine is true damage, and nothing states that Highlander's slow immunity nullifies Crippling Strike.
audit.why: Building armour against a true-damage execute is a losing plan, and channelling Meditate into a pull is how the trade ends.
audit.corrected: E = Apprehend (26/23.5/21/18.5/16s), pull plus knockup, cancels Meditate, and its passive shreds armour. R = Noxian Guillotine (120/100/80s), TRUE damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks, refreshed on a kill — Alpha Strike's untargetability is the only answer. W = Crippling Strike, an auto reset and slow; Highlander's slow immunity blanks it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds is never named in the content layer.
audit.why: Decimate heals him off every champion hit by the blade, on a 5s cooldown at rank 5 — that heal is what makes his extended trades win, and armour does not touch it.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal named in spikes[0].text and late.

edits.before: This is Darius's whole game — if he lands the Decimate outer-blade heal and pulls you in with Apprehension, his passive Hemorrhage stacks bleed you out before you can Alpha Strike away.
edits.after: This is Darius's whole game — Apprehend (E, 26s at rank 1) pulls you onto the Decimate outer blade, which heals him, and Hemorrhage bleeds you out. Buy Grievous Wounds; armour does nothing to the bleed.

edits.before: His Noxian Guillotine is a reset execute; at level 6 you're roughly even only because you can Meditate through the bleed and Alpha Strike out before he stacks five Hemorrhage.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine (R, 120s at rank 1) is true damage and refreshes on a kill — armour is no answer. Alpha Strike's untargetable window is, so hold it for his leap and not for the wave.

edits.after: Once your attack speed is online you out-DPS him in a clean fight: Highlander's 85s slow immunity ignores Crippling Strike, so his W can no longer set up the Apprehend pull.

edits.before: At level 2 his outer-blade heal and Apprehension threat keep you off the wave.
edits.after: At level 2 his outer-blade heal and the Apprehend pull keep you off the wave.

edits.before: At 6 it's roughly even since Meditate and Alpha Strike let you survive and escape his Guillotine setup.

notes: His E was named 'Apprehension' throughout the content layer; the real name is Apprehend.
